meta.description: Maintenance action frames. downtime_h = typical outage while the action is performed; cost = relative cost level 1 (very low) … 5 (very high) incl. parts and labour; safety_gain = how much the action reduces immediate risk to people/equipment (0–1). Values are knowledge-engineer estimates (see report §4.5 Assumptions) and can be refined from CMMS history.

stop_loto.name: Stop the machine and apply lockout/tagout (LOTO)
steps: Stop the machine from the local station
Isolate and lock all energy sources (electrical, pressure, stored energy)
Verify zero energy before any work

switch_to_standby.name: Transfer duty to the standby unit
steps: Start and prove the standby unit
Isolate the faulty unit for maintenance

reduce_load.name: Reduce load/speed and run under close watch
steps: Reduce throughput/load to the minimum acceptable
Assign an operator to monitor temperature, noise and vibration every hour

increase_monitoring.name: Increase condition-monitoring frequency (trend vibration/temperature)
steps: Set alarm limits on the trend
Re-run diagnosis when the trend changes

vibration_analysis.name: Detailed vibration analysis (spectrum, phase, axial readings)
steps: Take radial and axial spectra at each bearing

laser_alignment.name: Laser shaft alignment to tolerance
steps: Align with a laser tool to the coupling tolerance

check_pipe_strain.name: Check and relieve pipe strain; support piping
steps: Unbolt flanges and check they stay aligned

fix_soft_foot.name: Correct soft foot and re-torque hold-down bolts
steps: Check each foot with a dial gauge
Shim and torque bolts to specification

replace_bearing.name: Replace the bearing (clean installation, correct fits)
steps: Remove bearing; keep it for failure analysis

relubricate.name: Relubricate with the correct grease and quantity

lube_schedule.name: Correct the relubrication schedule/quantity in the CMMS

insulated_bearings.name: Install insulated bearing / shaft-grounding ring (VFD motors)
steps: Fit an insulated NDE bearing or a shaft-grounding ring

restore_npsha.name: Restore NPSH available (raise suction level, open suction valve, clean strainer, cool liquid)
steps: Raise the suction vessel level / open the suction valve fully

operate_near_bep.name: Move the operating point towards BEP (valve/VFD/impeller trim)
steps: Adjust discharge valve or VFD speed to bring flow to 70–120 % of BEP
Review system curve if not achievable

inspect_impeller.name: Open the pump and inspect impeller/wear rings
steps: Inspect for cavitation pitting, erosion, wear-ring clearance

suction_redesign.name: Engineering review of suction system (NPSH margin)
steps: Consider larger suction line, raised tank, booster or lower-NPSH pump

dry_run_protection.name: Install dry-run protection (level switch / power monitor)

clear_impeller.name: Open the pump and clear impeller/suction obstruction
steps: Remove debris from impeller and suction

install_strainer.name: Install/upgrade suction strainer and cleaning routine
steps: Fit a strainer with ΔP gauge

replace_wear_parts.name: Restore clearances: replace wear rings / impeller

contain_leak.name: Contain leakage and isolate hazardous liquid (spill procedure)
steps: Barricade area and remove ignition sources

replace_mech_seal.name: Replace mechanical seal
steps: Replace seal; check shaft sleeve and run-out

restore_seal_flush.name: Restore seal flush / cooling plan
steps: Verify flow and pressure to the seal chamber

correct_supply_balance.name: Correct supply voltage unbalance (loads, taps, connections)
steps: Measure line voltages at the motor and the MCC
Redistribute single-phase loads, check transformer taps and tighten connections

phase_protection.name: Install phase-loss / unbalance protection relay
steps: Set trip at the agreed unbalance limit

repair_open_phase.name: Find and repair the open phase (fuses, contactor poles, terminals)
steps: Check fuses, contactor contacts, overload relay and terminals
Replace faulty part; check all three line voltages before restart

insulation_test.name: Insulation tests (IR, PI, surge) before re-energising

repair_rotor.name: Repair or replace the rotor cage

soft_start.name: Limit starts/hour; fit soft starter or VFD
steps: Review start frequency against motor data
Fit soft starter/VFD for high-inertia loads

reduce_mech_load.name: Remove the cause of overload (binding, jam, excess load)
steps: Uncouple and turn by hand to check binding
Clear jams; verify load against motor rating

resize_motor.name: Re-rate/resize motor for the actual load
steps: Select motor with adequate output and service factor

replace_tool.name: Replace the cutting tool
steps: Replace tool and reset wear counter

tool_change_policy.name: Preventive tool change before 200 min of wear
steps: Set tool-life limit in the CNC tool table

increase_speed_cooling.name: Increase spindle speed / improve process cooling
steps: Raise speed above 1380 rpm where the process allows

check_coolant.name: Check coolant/ventilation system
steps: Check coolant level, flow and cooler

adjust_cutting_parameters.name: Adjust torque/speed to keep power within 3.5–9 kW

check_spindle_drive.name: Inspect spindle drive and power supply
steps: Check drive alarms, supply and spindle load meter

reduce_cutting_load.name: Reduce cutting torque (feed/depth) for the worn tool

withdraw_train.name: Take the train out of passenger service
steps: Do not restart service until pressure holds above 8.2 bar

leak_test.name: Pressure-decay leak test
steps: Fill to 10 bar and stop the compressor
Record the pressure drop over 10 minutes
Use soapy water on joints to find the leak

repair_air_leak.name: Repair the air leak
steps: Isolate and vent the affected section
Replace the leaking fitting, hose or seal

service_dryer_valves.name: Service the air-dryer valves
steps: Check tower changeover and drain valves

duty_cycle_alarm.name: Alarm on compressor duty cycle
steps: Alert when the compressor is loaded > 80 % of 30 minutes

periodic_leak_survey.name: Monthly leak survey
steps: Ultrasonic or soap-test survey of joints every month

check_oil_cooler.name: Inspect the oil cooler
steps: Check the fan and the thermostatic valve
